All 73 cited register ids resolve (70 active, 3 partial, flagged), and the population, contractor and prevailing-wage sentences are identical to the CCG. The r1 empty-template defect is closed. The file still fails on content against the CCG and MANDATE. Two in-scope filings are missing with no descoping record (NV MBT, Seattle PET/SHT: blocker). The insurance_type mapper and wage-type categories drop modelled payroll items (WC employee shares and fees, VT CCC, OR STT, the US-OWN-007 levy set, city employer payroll taxes), which the _comment rule would exclude from every artifact. findings.location: scope_manifest.json!authority_filings.in_scope!entries 0-15 have no NV MBT entry and no Seattle entry (source: _pipeline/scope/build_scope_manifest.py)
findings.problem: Two filings that the CCG keeps in scope are missing from authority_filings.in_scope and have no descoping record in authority_filings.out_of_scope. (1) Nevada Modified Business Tax quarterly return, Form TAX-F003 V2026.1. CCG Annex NV.5 T704r2 states nv.report.mbt.due 'last day of month after quarter (file even if no tax)' [US-NVS5-010], and NV.3 T702r7-r10 models the 1.17 % tax. (2) Seattle Payroll Expense Tax and Seattle Social Housing Tax quarterly city returns. The tier verdict (copied verbatim into this file) declares Seattle PET 'a threshold-conditional employer tax on a city return [US-WAP51-001]' as a T4-shaped element, CCG WA.2 P5385 states the same, and build-manifest tier.by_domain.employer_payroll_levies lists it. WA is also absent from the 'Local income / wage tax returns' annex list. The file's own _in_scope_note says the Report Specifications 'must cover every filing above', so Stage 3 would build no spec for either filing. This is a filing dropped without a descoping decision (F15/F21).
findings.expected: Add two in_scope entries, through build_scope_manifest.py and never by hand. (a) 'Nevada Modified Business Tax return (Form TAX-F003, general business)', authority Nevada Department of Taxation, frequency 'quarterly; due last day of the month after the quarter (file even if no tax)', format 'My Nevada Tax e-file or paper', integration_type outbound, product_mapping_required true, register_ids [US-NVS5-010], ccg_location 'CCG Annex NV.3, NV.5'. (b) 'Seattle Payroll Expense Tax and Social Housing Tax returns (City of Seattle, threshold-conditional employer taxes)', authority City of Seattle (Department of Finance and Administrative Services), frequency 'quarterly (2026: Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31)', format 'FileLocal / city return; Taxpayer Authorization Form for payroll processors', outbound, product_mapping_required true, register_ids [US-WAP51-001, US-WAP7-005, US-WAP9V-001], ccg_location 'CCG Annex WA.2, WA.5'. If the build lead descopes either one, it goes to out_of_scope with a descoping_reason and an owner / US-OWN register id. Then add both to the employer-contribution wage-type category and the insurance_type mapper (finding 3).
findings.evidence: WebFetch 2026-11-02: tax.nv.gov TAX-F003 V2026.1 reads 'Line 8 x .0117', 'threshold of $50,000', 'due ... the last day of the month following the applicable quarter'. The seattle.gov payroll-expense-tax page reads 'due quarterly beginning April 30, 2026', thresholds 9,074,409 / 194,452, and requires the 'Taxpayer Authorization Form' from payroll processors. CCG dump (md5 2de2b30c) P5385, T704r2, T702r7.

findings.location: scope_manifest.json!authority_filings.in_scope!ccg_location of entries 'Local income / wage tax returns (per locality)' and 'State SDI / TDI / PFML / long-term-care premium reports where separate'
findings.problem: Separate and piggy-backed returns are classified against the MANDATE tier census. (a) The local-returns entry (authority 'Local taxing authority', format 'per locality channel') lists annexes AL, CO, DE, IN, KY, MD, MI, MO, NJ, NY, OH, OR, PA, WV. MANDATE local_income_tax row, the tier verdict and CCG m10 10.1 P619 say a separate local return exists in exactly 11 jurisdictions (PA, OH, MI, KY, MO, AL, CO, DE, OR, WV, NJ). IN county tax, MD county tax (MW506) and NYC/Yonkers (NYS-45/NYS-1) are piggy-backed on the State return: T3, no locality return. (b) The SDI/TDI/PFML 'where separate' entry lists CA, CO, CT, DE, HI, MA, ME, MD, MN, NJ, NY, OR, RI, VT, WA. MANDATE sdi_tdi_pfml row says CA SDI and OR Paid Leave are filed with the State wage return, and NY DBL/PFL and HI TDI are insurer-funded with no State report. CCG VT.3 P5249 says VT has no mandatory SDI/PFML (vt.sdi_pfml.exists=False), and the VT Child Care Contribution goes on WHT-436, the withholding return. The RSPEC builder would build locality specs that do not exist and miss the classification the tier rests on.
findings.expected: (a) Local returns ccg_location = 'CCG m06; m10 10.1; annexes AL, CO, DE, KY, MI, MO, NJ, OH, OR, PA, WV section 2c (+ WA, see finding 1)', with a note on the State withholding entry: 'IN county, MD county (MW506) and NYC/Yonkers (NYS-45/NYS-1) are piggy-backed on the State withholding return (T3), not separate locality returns [US-INS5-007, US-MDP51-001, US-NY-008].' (b) SDI/PFML 'where separate' = the MANDATE sdi_tdi_pfml separate set (WA PFML + WA Cares, CT, CO, DE, ME, MD from 2027-01-01), plus any other annex whose section 5 shows a separate programme report (MA DFML, MN Paid Leave, NJ, RI: confirm each from its annex section 5). Note CA SDI and OR Paid Leave as filed on the State wage return and NY/HI as insurer-funded, and remove VT. Wording must match the MANDATE classification.
findings.evidence: MANDATE.md lines 36-38 (local_income_tax, sdi_tdi_pfml rows); CCG dump P619 (m10 10.1), P5249 and P5250 (VT.3).

findings.location: scope_manifest.json!option_mapper_scope.insurance_type and wage_type_categories.in_scope!entries 'Employee programme contributions' and 'Employer contributions'
findings.problem: The insurance_type mapper and the wage-type categories omit payroll items that the CCG models. The file's own _comment says 'Out-of-scope codes must be excluded from ALL artifacts', so the DD and WTC would drop them (F2 in reverse). Missing employee deductions: WA workers' compensation employee share (wa.wc.employee_deduction.rule, CCG m07 7.1 T83r4, WA.3 P5399 [US-WAS5-019]); NM workers' compensation fee, employee 2.25 / employer 2.55 USD per quarter on TRD-41431 (CCG m05 5.1 P287, NM.3 [US-NMR3-001]); OR Workers' Benefit Fund, half employee and half employer, on Form OQ (OR.3 T755r14); VT Child Care Contribution, employee up to 0.11 % (VT.3 P5250 [US-VTS5-030]); OR statewide transit tax (employee, OR.3 P4124). Missing employer levies: the US-OWN-007 set beyond OR/NY transit (State workforce / administrative / solvency levies, e.g. MA COVID-19 Recovery Assessment and EMAC, GA administrative assessment, AR administrative assessment), NV MBT, and the city employer payroll taxes the tier reason lists (Jersey City, Newark, Seattle PET/SHT, St. Louis payroll expense tax, Pittsburgh PET, Denver OPT). US-OWN-007 is represented as 'transit levies OR and NY only'. That wording is only limb 1 of the decision.
findings.expected: insurance_type adds scope labels for WORKERS_COMP_EMPLOYEE_SHARE (WA L&I, OR WBF), WORKERS_COMP_FEE_NM, CHILD_CARE_CONTRIBUTION_VT, STATEWIDE_TRANSIT_TAX_OR, STATE_UI_ADMIN_SOLVENCY_LEVY, STATE_EMPLOYER_PAYROLL_TAX (NV MBT) and CITY_EMPLOYER_PAYROLL_TAX (NJ Jersey City/Newark, WA Seattle PET/SHT, MO St. Louis, PA Pittsburgh, CO Denver OPT employer). Each label carries its register basis in _insurance_type_basis, and the wording quotes US-OWN-007 in full (transit levies OR and NY; workforce/administrative/solvency levies per the P7 list; NH BET excluded). wage_type_categories gets the same items under employee and employer contributions. Labels stay scope labels; the DD assigns codes (C27 at DD close).
findings.evidence: CCG dump P287, T83r4c1, P5399, T689r5-r8, T755r14, P4124, P5250; build-manifest tier.by_domain.employer_payroll_levies; register US-OWN-007 figure_or_rule_carried.
